sn14.14:1.2: Here “element” means something like a “personality trait”.
sn14.14:1.3: _Adhimuttika_ appears to be a Buddhist coinage. The key text is the Divine Net Discourse [dn1](), where the Buddha’s ability to discern the different “convictions” of beings is illustrated with the examples of Suppiya who criticized the Buddha, Dhamma, and Saṅgha, while his student Brahmadatta praised them. This speaks to a difference in faith, a quality closely associated with _adhimutta_ (eg. [an1.208:1.1]()). DN 1 goes on to discuss the various views, using the unique term _adhimuttipadāni_ (“hypotheses”, “statements of conviction”), which clearly draws on _adhimutti_ in the introduction.
